title: RAFT as a plug-in objective for published forecasters (PatchTST, iTransformer)
question: Does the RAFT auxiliary objective (target-aware relational loss L_RT + conflict-free update), with tau=0.1 and N_max=512 as for F, and the weight alpha selected per backbone on validation data by the same rule as for F, improve published forecasters of different design (channel-independent PatchTST; channel-mixing iTransformer)?
arms: raft_a<alpha selected per backbone in the pilot>

raft.alpha: selected per backbone in the pilot from {0.1, 0.3, 1}
raft.losses: L_RT only (these backbones have no frequency branch, so L_TF and the FD component do not apply)

backbone_settings: official per-dataset hyperparameters and look-back of each model (PatchTST_supervised scripts: L=336, ILI L=104; iTransformer scripts: L=96, ILI L=36); Exchange uses the PatchTST ETTh configuration (no official script). Same splits, scaling and data files as Stage X.

patchtst.lr_schedule: type3: constant for 3 epochs, then x0.9 per epoch

selection: best validation MSE checkpoint; test evaluated once; nothing is tuned on test

claims_and_tests.P1: RAFT improves each backbone: per backbone, Wilcoxon signed-rank test on the per-setting mean paired differences in test RMSE (raft - base) over the 22 settings, two-sided; wins/ties/losses at 0.1%; per-setting 95% bootstrap CI over the 3 paired seeds (descriptive).
claims_and_tests.P2: Overall: Friedman test and Nemenyi CD over methods {F, F+TFB, F+RAFT, PatchTST, PatchTST+RAFT, iTransformer, iTransformer+RAFT, DLinear, RevIN-Linear} on the settings where all are available.

note: Post-hoc and secondary: conflict rate and cosine of the gradients.

pilot.rule: Per backbone, select the alpha with the lowest mean over the pilot settings of (mean best-validation MSE of RAFT / that of base, same 3 seeds). Ties (<1e-4): smaller alpha. Test data are not used. The selected alpha is used for all 22 settings of that backbone; if no alpha has ratio < 1 it is still carried forward and the report states that no improvement is expected.
